intent: Implement the fourteen findings from the build 133 status export: grounded reporting, bounded review recovery, task intent, paging and identity, serialization, privacy messaging, budgets and durable diagnostics.

focused_kotlin_host.scope: Production Kotlin logic with platform/backend boundary stubs; not an Android build or live API test

remaining: Full Android unit tests, APK build and lint in CI
Real device/provider stress testing remains unexecuted
solutions: Render stress/test reports from deduplicated trusted receipts; zero executions produce no synthetic rates or timings.
Publish supported partial observations and preserve original task identity; distinguish answer availability from task acceptance.
Allow one explicit verdict-format repair, cap review passes at 32, persist blocked unchanged reviews and cache completed verdicts.
Bind numerical statements to exact fact pointers; reject numbers borrowed from unrelated fields and compact review metadata.
Accept only matching read selectors on saved cursors, including response detail and CI identities; preserve scope isolation.
Stop remote paging after has_more=false within a short freshness window; saved fragments and refreshed page-one reads remain available.
Use a deterministic three-read status sequence; existing continuation recovery supplies the original task.
Filter latest workflow and checks to the selected branch commit; historical runs do not advance branch-head evidence epochs.
Validate workflow/run/revision identities and honor workflow definition selectors.
Report successful, skipped and running checks separately; no inference of required-check compliance or merge readiness.
Retain oversized JSON text as bounded valid JSON with explicit truncation metadata.
Scope local-only privacy errors to the rejected tool while preserving the existing authorization boundary.
Use a conservative unknown Llama context ceiling, bounded status output, tools-disabled verdict reasoning, and the saved reasoning preference.
Persist safe timing and stage/failure metadata in receipts/checkpoints independently of verbose logs.

activity_follow_up.intent: Replace fixed GitHub placeholder with immediate task introduction and 20-second white activity summaries, followed by faded previews; animate only the latest bottom preview with the loading-bar cycle.
behavior: Immediate task-specific introduction, then activity summaries every 20 seconds without another provider invocation
White summaries append below previous faded preview lines in chronological order
New summaries enter downward over 300 ms with linear easing
Preview opacity remains 50 percent; only the bottommost preview pans on the loading bar’s 1800 ms cycle
Repeated gradient endpoints avoid a visible wrap jump; completed, active and next-step text comes from observed events
Stable progress identities preserve downward entry animations when old history is trimmed
